title: What is Kaidra?
text: Kaidra is an AI agent platform built specifically for fitness studios and wellness centres. It provides 24/7 automated agents that handle lead conversion, member retention, and customer support — so your studio never misses an enquiry, even outside business hours. Kaidra agents respond in under 3 seconds, book appointments, follow up with leads, and support existing members, all without needing a human to be available.

title: Who is Kaidra for?
text: Kaidra is designed for fitness studios, gyms, and wellness centres of all sizes. Whether you run a single-location boutique studio or a growing multi-location fitness brand, Kaidra helps you automate customer conversations, convert more leads, and retain existing members — without hiring extra staff. Studios already using Kaidra include Anytime Fitness, F45 Training, and BFT.

title: What is Kaidra's Mission?
text: Kaidra's mission is to help fitness businesses scale their conversations and grow revenue through intelligent AI agents. The platform is built on the belief that no lead should go unanswered and no member should churn simply because your team was unavailable. Kaidra gives fitness studios the power of a 24/7 sales and support team — without the overhead.

title: Which Studios Trust Kaidra?
text: Kaidra is trusted by a growing number of fitness studios and wellness businesses. Known brands that have used Kaidra include Anytime Fitness, F45 Training, and BFT. These studios use Kaidra to automate lead follow-up, member engagement, and customer support across channels like WhatsApp, Instagram, and SMS.

title: What AI Agents Does Kaidra Offer?
text: Kaidra offers three core AI agents that work together to cover the full member lifecycle for a fitness studio. The first is the Lead Conversion Agent, which engages new enquiries and books appointments. The second is the Retention and Upsell Agent, which identifies at-risk members and re-engages them before they cancel. The third is the Support and Staff Copilot, which handles FAQs, scheduling, and day-to-day support tasks. Together, these three agents ensure your studio is responsive, proactive, and efficient at every stage of the customer journey.

title: Are Kaidra Agents Available 24/7?
text: Yes. Kaidra agents operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including weekends and public holidays. They respond to enquiries in under 3 seconds, meaning no lead ever has to wait. Whether a prospect messages your studio at 2am or a member asks a question during a public holiday, Kaidra responds instantly without requiring any human involvement.

title: What is the Lead Conversion Agent?
text: The Lead Conversion Agent is Kaidra's sales-focused AI that engages new prospects the moment they reach out to your studio. It answers their questions, shares information about your offers and classes, and guides them toward booking a trial or appointment — all automatically. It also sends follow-up messages to nurture leads who showed interest but haven't booked yet, ensuring no opportunity is lost.

title: What Can the Lead Conversion Agent Do?
text: The Lead Conversion Agent can: instantly respond to new enquiries across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and SMS; answer questions about memberships, classes, pricing, and offers; book trial appointments and consultations directly in your CRM or booking system; send automated follow-up messages to leads who haven't responded; and nurture trial users with reminders and check-ins to convert them into paying members.

title: What is the Retention and Upsell Agent?
text: The Retention and Upsell Agent monitors your existing member base and identifies members who are at risk of cancelling or going inactive. It automatically sends personalised re-engagement messages at the right time to bring them back before they churn. It also looks for upsell opportunities — recommending relevant upgrades, packages, or add-ons to members who are ready for more.

title: What Can the Retention Agent Do?
text: The Retention and Upsell Agent can: identify members who have not attended recently or are showing signs of disengagement; send personalised re-engagement messages to bring them back; trigger rebooking reminders at optimal times; recommend membership upgrades or additional services based on member behaviour; and automate upsell and cross-sell messaging to increase revenue per member without manual effort from your team.

title: What is the Support and Staff Copilot?
text: The Support and Staff Copilot is Kaidra's operational AI agent. It handles the day-to-day customer support tasks that would otherwise keep your front-desk team busy — answering frequently asked questions, managing scheduling and reminder messages, and providing instant member information. It also acts as a copilot for your staff, giving them quick access to client insights so they can have more informed conversations.

title: What Can the Support and Staff Copilot Do?
text: The Support and Staff Copilot can: answer common member questions about classes, bookings, and studio policies at any time of day; send scheduling reminders and class confirmations; reduce front-desk workload by handling repetitive enquiries automatically; provide staff with instant client insights to improve in-person conversations; and escalate complex issues to a human team member when needed.

title: How Does Kaidra Work?
text: Getting started with Kaidra is a simple three-step process. First, you onboard and explore — you meet Kaidra's dedicated team, share details about your studio, and get access to the Agent Lab to test how the AI will respond to your specific customers. Second, you connect and configure — your CRM, booking system, lead sources, and communication channels are all integrated and the agent workflows are set up for your studio. Third, you go live and scale — your subscription is activated and Kaidra starts handling conversations 24/7 from that point forward.

title: Step 1 — Onboard and Explore
text: In the first step of getting started with Kaidra, you meet the dedicated onboarding team who will guide you through the entire setup. You share details about your studio — your offers, tone of voice, frequently asked questions, and business goals. You also get access to the Agent Lab, where you can test the AI agent and see exactly how it will respond to your customers before going live.

title: Step 2 — Connect and Configure
text: In the second step, Kaidra connects to your existing systems. This includes integrating with your CRM or booking platform (such as Mindbody, Glofox, or Hapana), connecting your communication channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS), and linking your lead sources. The agent workflows are then configured specifically for your studio's needs — so the AI knows exactly how to handle enquiries, follow-ups, and member conversations.

title: Step 3 — Go Live and Scale
text: In the third step, your Kaidra subscription is activated and your AI agents go live. From this point, Kaidra operates 24/7 — engaging new leads, following up with prospects, supporting existing members, and handling operational queries automatically. As your studio grows, Kaidra scales with you, handling increasing volumes of conversations without any extra effort on your part.

title: Which Channels Does Kaidra Support?
text: Kaidra agents operate across multiple communication channels so you can reach your leads and members wherever they are. Supported channels include WhatsApp, Instagram Direct Messages, Facebook Messenger, SMS, and web messaging. This means a prospect can message your studio on Instagram at midnight and receive an instant, helpful response — without any human involvement.

title: Does Kaidra Work on WhatsApp?
text: Yes. WhatsApp is one of Kaidra's primary supported channels. Your AI agent can engage with leads and members via WhatsApp Business, sending and receiving messages, booking appointments, answering questions, and following up — all through WhatsApp. This is particularly effective for fitness studios in markets where WhatsApp is the preferred communication channel.

title: Does Kaidra Work on Instagram?
text: Yes. Kaidra supports Instagram Direct Messages. When a prospect or member sends a DM to your studio's Instagram account, Kaidra responds instantly with the relevant information — whether it's about membership pricing, class schedules, or booking a trial. This ensures your Instagram account becomes an active sales and support channel, not just a content feed.

title: What Systems Does Kaidra Integrate With?
text: Kaidra integrates with the most widely used fitness and business tools, including Mindbody, Glofox, Hapana, Zapier, Calendly, and Stripe. These integrations allow Kaidra to read and update your booking system, process payments where applicable, connect lead sources, and automate workflows — all without manual data entry. If you use a system not listed here, contact the Kaidra team to discuss compatibility.

title: Does Kaidra Integrate with Mindbody, Glofox or Hapana?
text: Yes. Kaidra has native integrations with Mindbody, Glofox, and Hapana — three of the most popular CRM and booking platforms used by fitness studios. Once connected, Kaidra can check availability, book appointments, access member information, and update records directly within your existing system. This means your team always has accurate, up-to-date information without any manual syncing.

text: Yes. Kaidra integrates with both Zapier and Calendly. The Zapier integration allows you to connect Kaidra with hundreds of other apps and automate custom workflows beyond the standard setup. The Calendly integration enables Kaidra to book appointments and consultations directly into your Calendly calendar, without requiring a lead to visit a separate booking page.

title: How is Kaidra Different from a Chatbot?
text: Kaidra is very different from a traditional chatbot. A standard chatbot follows fixed scripts and can only respond to exact keywords — it breaks down quickly when a customer asks something unexpected. Kaidra uses advanced conversational AI that understands natural language, handles complex and varied questions, remembers context across a conversation, and adapts its tone to match your studio's brand. It behaves more like a knowledgeable team member than a scripted bot.

title: How Can I Trust Kaidra to Talk to My Customers?
text: Kaidra is built specifically for fitness studios, which means it is trained and configured around your studio's specific information — your offers, policies, classes, and tone of voice. Before going live, you test the agent in the Agent Lab to see exactly how it responds to your customers' questions. You can also review conversations at any time and step in whenever needed. The agent is designed to stay within the boundaries of what your studio has approved.

title: What if Kaidra Doesn't Know How to Answer Something?
text: If Kaidra encounters a question it cannot confidently answer, it does not guess or make up information. Instead, it handles the situation gracefully — either asking a clarifying question, letting the customer know that a team member will follow up, or escalating the conversation to a human staff member. This ensures your customers always receive an honest and appropriate response, even in edge cases.
